scope: Direct full-grid no-hand convex-phone CPU validation, then matched Warp only if CPU passes. This author performs no physics.

history_and_selection_scope.v3_failure: V3selected pair[.000625,.0003125] passed nominal screening but failed its fresh full grid: .1kg/mu.3 push final orientation differed2.809482299851326deg across dt, above unchanged2deg. All54G1-G6 and the other26G7 pairs passed.
history_and_selection_scope.interpretation: This is a separately frozen sequential engineering condition motivated by a known failure, not a fallback success inside v3, independent blind scientific confirmation, parameter identification or ego-trajectory generalization.

frozen_references.rule: Resolve only the exact pinned source documents. No changes to geometry, COM, uniformbbox inertia, solver tolerance1e-6/ls_tolerance.01, condim3/pyramidal, solimp, refsafe, damping1, force schedule or numerical/physical acceptance thresholds.

fixed_grid.order: nominal(.2,.6)first,remaining mass/mu lexicographic,then dt as listed,then tests as listed

test_summary.initial_hull_support: Unchanged compiled-hull support function plus Rx90 and COM-offset compensation; retain raw support inputs/results.

decision_rule.CPU_pass: All54 G1-G6, all27 unchanged G7 timestep comparisons, valid pinned sampled geometry and complete source/input/raw arithmetic audit must pass. Integrity/completeness is distinct from physical gates.
decision_rule.if_CPU_pass: Only then execute the exact same54 grid on Warp with the same fixed tau/dt pair and supported diagnostics, then assess unchanged G8.
decision_rule.if_CPU_fail: Keep full54 raw results, exact failed metrics and all original gates; do not authorize v4GPU confirmation. Further diagnosis may be saved-only; further physics or parameter changes require a new declared condition.

output_ABI.raw_case_ABI: Unchanged pinned run_case1b688 arrays,24-column original contact table including native frame/force, raw qacc, POST phase, warning changes and source-backed compiled options. New driver retains all54 original raw pins.
output_ABI.trajectory_pins: Canonical map of all54 exact case IDs to original raw pins.
output_ABI.Warp_guard: Check exact protocol and positive complete CPUassessment plus map54 before actual GPU; default metadata may not pretend to have validated device runtime options.

execution_binding.before_first_integration: Archive new fixed-grid driver, common4460, capture1b688, this protocol and all referenced input pins; retain source reviews, model/hull/visual/models_info, actual compiled options and raw support initial state. Bind complete process stdout/stderr.
execution_binding.actual_options: Keep CPUtol1e-6 and ls_tol.01; before GPU integration validate the actual device FP32 representations and all capacities. Keep supported9bit sticky overflow/finite/log evidence; a CPU-style GPUwarning table is NOT_AVAILABLE, not a fabricated zero vector.
execution_binding.physical_count: 54cases/777600steps per backend; native nonintegrating captures separately counted, not mislabeled physical steps.

scope_limits: Even if all numerical gates pass, this is a sampled convex-geometry/no-hand engineering bench under unmeasured mass/COM/inertia/friction assumptions. It does not calibrate a real phone, validate grasp/control or human forces, qualify cup/old policy, or perform ego retargeting.
